Record Class PetriObjectGroupRef

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.PetriObjectGroupRef
Record Components:
name - the group's name
memberObjects - indices of its member objects, in stamping order
templateMethod - the net library method the shared net came from, or null
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record PetriObjectGroupRef(String name, List<Integer> memberObjects, String templateMethod, String modelId, List<String> templateArguments) extends Record implements Serializable
A group of Petri-objects as a saved document states it: a name and the objects that belong to it, addressed the way every other link in the document addresses an object — by index.

The counterpart of GraphObjectGroup, which is the live thing on the canvas. They are kept apart for the same reason a link is a GraphPlaceFusion on the canvas and a PetriObjLink in the model: one holds references to drawn objects, the other holds positions, and positions are what survives being written to a file and read back.

A group carries no semantics of its own. It says these objects were stamped together, which lets the editor go on treating them as one; the model those objects make up is exactly the model they would make up without it. That is why a reader may ignore this entirely and still read the document correctly — and why it is written as tool-specific information rather than asked of the PNML grammar, which has nothing to say about it.
